test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: According to the time by Rohan's watch, it is half past 6 and the watch's hands are pointing to the south. In which of the given directions will the minute-hand point AFTER exactly 24 hours?
solution:
• At half past 6, the hands of the clock are pointing south as shown below:
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03ceafd59106becae61c5a202aa58ee56b0fe542990302a152ea5cc1f45b8423.png] 
 
• After exactly 24 hours, the time will be half past 6 again.
 
• So, the hands of the clock will be pointing south again.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03ceafd59106becae61c5a202aa58ee56b0fe542990302a152ea5cc1f45b8423.png] 
 
• Hence, "south" is the correct answer.
